description: Planned model replacement experiments. These are comparison plans, not active runtime dependencies.

experiments.candidate: Current number OCR with threshold/crop tuning
pass_criteria: No increase in count jump warnings after smoothing
Count rows remain stable on match_1 and new analysis windows
experiments.notes: Prefer this before replacing the detector because count OCR currently shows direct jump noise.

experiments.candidate: YOLO11n or YOLOv8n fine-tuned on current UI labels
pass_criteria: Reduce missing player-state rows without breaking 33-column CSV output
Runtime stays acceptable on local hardware
experiments.notes: Keep YOLOv5 as the control until labeled UI detection data is prepared.

pass_criteria: Improve validation/test accuracy over ResNet18 baseline
No increase in unstable weapon rows on evaluation CSVs
experiments.notes: Current dataset/label/model class counts are aligned; replace only after a measured classifier baseline exists.

pass_criteria: Manual precision improves on sampled message frames
Runtime does not block offline analysis
experiments.notes: Message OCR is currently conservative; do not prioritize until message samples matter for downstream features.

experiments.candidate: Learned marker detector or improved color-calibrated tracker
pass_criteria: Improve manual point-label recall once labels are filled
experiments.notes: Current color-calibrated MVP is usable, but anomaly samples show where marker identity is unstable.
